content.title: The Nicene Creed (381)
content.author: Council of Constantinople, 381 · traditional English text, as held in this site's creeds collection
content.note: The creed of Nicaea (325) as enlarged at Constantinople (381), in the traditional English text with the Western clause on the Spirit proceeding “from the Father and the Son”. It identifies the doctrine being defended; it is not independent historical evidence for every claim. Public domain: may be quoted, with an exact locator (paragraphs 1–5 of the site's text).
content.read: Read whole on 2026-11-27 in this site's creeds collection (from the Creeds.json transcription, The Unlicense; registered 2026-10-17): five paragraphs, on the Father (1), the Son (2–3), the Holy Spirit (4) and the church and the life to come (5). Cited for the Trinity and for the confession concerning Jesus Christ.
